svg.title: Three ways to run Instana, counted by host
svg.desc: IBM offers Instana as SaaS, self-hosted, and pay per use. Each is counted in Managed Virtual Servers: a physical machine, a virtual server or a worker node. A standard license starts at 10 hosts.
